scope: WebSocket Topic Authorization, Periodic Session Revalidation, Session Revocation on Role Changes, Audit Contract Alignment, Fail-Closed Compensating Transactions, Programmatic Route Introspection Matrix, and Mass-Assignment Schema Hardening
verdict: 100% HACKATHON-ACCEPTANCE COMPLETE FOR THE DEFINED P10 SECURITY SCOPE

closed_items.title: WebSocket Wildcard Topic Expansion Strictly Excludes Unauthorized Families
closed_items.description: Removed '*' from _TOPIC_PERMISSIONS; wildcard subscriptions expand exclusively into explicit permitted event families (CAMERA, ALERT, SIGHTING, TARGET, ROUTE, SYSTEM). Tested with live event publishing proving unauthorized AUDIT and USER events are never queued for or delivered to lower-privileged connections.

closed_items.title: Periodic WebSocket Session & Permission Revalidation
closed_items.description: Implemented background validation loop in websocket_events_endpoint that re-verifies session validity and user enablement against the repository; terminated sessions close with code 4401.

closed_items.title: Session Revocation Across Devices on Role Mutation
closed_items.description: PATCH /api/v1/users/{id} immediately revokes all active user sessions whenever a user's role is updated, requiring the user to re-authenticate under their new role.

closed_items.title: AuditPage Contract Alignment with Backend Schema
closed_items.description: Aligned 09_dashboard/src/api/audit.ts and AuditPage.tsx to use audit_id, event_time_utc, actor_username, and actor_role matching 08_backend/schemas/audit.py. Added dedicated Vitest frontend component test.

closed_items.title: Compensating Transactions on Audit Log Failure
closed_items.description: Implemented targeted snapshot and compensation logic across target creation, target update, target disabling, user updates, and password resets to restore previous state if fail-closed audit log persistence raises an exception.

closed_items.title: Programmatic FastAPI Route Introspection Matrix
closed_items.description: Dynamic route introspection iterates all registered APIRoute instances in app.routes and verifies 401 unauthenticated and 403 unauthorized boundaries across all 4 roles.

closed_items.title: Strict Mass-Assignment Rejection via extra='forbid'
closed_items.description: Enforced model_config = ConfigDict(extra='forbid') on UserCreateRequest, UserUpdateRequest, UserResetPasswordRequest, TargetCreateRequest, TargetUpdateRequest, AlertAckRequest, LoginRequest, and ChangePasswordRequest.

closed_items.title: Truthful Sink Classification and Parameterization Verification
closed_items.description: Verified 100% parameterization on SQL queries and documented the complete absence of command/subprocess and path-traversal execution sinks across API routes.
